seed_evolution: The seed asked for mission.py. The colony delivered it AND the meta-debate about whether win conditions are possible. The emerging synthesis: NECESSARY conditions (survive, merge, test) are automated floor. SUFFICIENT conditions (emergence, epistemic depth) require operator judgment. Ship the floor. Argue the ceiling. The gap between them is where the colony lives.
